title: APA Numbers
summary: Write three formatting helpers you'll reuse in every report: fmt_num(), fmt_p() and fmt_bounded().
hints: `fmt_num <- function(x, digits = 2) formatC(x, format = "f", digits = digits)`.
`fmt_p` needs an `if`: `if (p < .001) "< .001" else paste("=", sub("^0", "", fmt_num(p, 3)))`.
`fmt_bounded <- function(x, digits = 2) sub("^(-?)0\\.", "\\1.", fmt_num(x, digits))` keeps a minus sign and drops the zero.
